protocol.revision_reason: Pilot directed-loop-only chains mixed poorly for weak exchange. Add a validated conditional worldline-cluster update, include g/D=0.25 in calibration, and rerun every comparison in a separate output directory. Original pilot records are retained. This revision follows sampling diagnostics and is exploratory.
protocol.data: Existing verified Weizmann single-object archive and masks; fixed source-level 25 calibration / 75 comparison split
protocol.reuse_limit: These 75 images appeared in prior Ising development. This is internal held-out comparison within the present protocol, not fresh external validation.
protocol.seeds: Same mask-derived background/foreground seeds, no spin clamp; primary background-seed Algorithm 1 signs
protocol.exchange_rule: Relative g=r*median(abs(Delta)); absolute g=1 is a separate comparison
protocol.screen: All 360 rules on 25 calibration images at 8x8. Two chains, short screen, never a final Gibbs claim.
protocol.refine: Within each model/threshold family retain the best two by mean uncertainty-lower IoU plus best by raw IoU; repeat on all 25 calibration 8x8 images with independent longer sampling.
protocol.selection: Highest mean uncertainty-lower IoU in each of eight model/threshold families, with failed Rhat cases scored zero; ties by raw IoU, then lexical rule ID. Also retain best overall Ising and XXZ.
protocol.objective: Lower IoU over all assignments of signs whose approximate simultaneous MCMC interval includes zero; not a rigorous finite-time MCMC confidence bound.
protocol.comparison: Each family winner on all 75 comparison images at 8x8 and 16x16; report every case including convergence failures. Classical baselines and exact Ising targets retained.
protocol.small: Overall winners on all 100 native 2x4 boundary crops; dense XXZ and exact Ising reference checks.
protocol.mechanism: Overall XXZ winner: g/median(abs(Delta))=0,.25,.5,1,2 and absolute g=1 with combined temperature normalization on all 75 8x8 comparison images, holding its other rules fixed. Exact classical controls at matched b: remove exchange, neutralize intermediate bonds, and match isolated-bond ZZ correlations.
protocol.confirmation: Re-run overall-winner comparison cases flagged by Rhat>=1.05 or undefined, or ESS<200, at the confirm budget; record separately, without changing rules. Also confirm the first five comparison IDs at 16x16 for both overall winners independent of scores.
protocol.uncertainty: Four diverse chain starts for final runs; block/chain SE, approximate Bonferroni-t sign intervals, unranked split Rhat, ESS estimate. Image bootstrap uses original source IDs. Weak signs and convergence failures must remain visible.
protocol.phase_interpretation: Delta>g, abs(Delta)<=g, Delta<-g are bond-level proxies for uniform-chain regimes, not phase identification on finite disordered 2D images.
protocol.numerical_method: Sign-free SSE diagonal heat bath, eight complete directed loops, and one conditional worldline-cluster update per sweep; fixed expansion cutoff tail < exp(-50). Signed-cluster plus heat-bath Ising sampling; exact row-transfer references through width16.

interval_note: Image bootstrap intervals are pointwise and conditional on estimated labels. MCMC sign ranges are approximate and require equilibration; Rhat does not prove convergence.
